The benchmark consists of a {{ds.n_docs}}-document corpus for a fictional cloud
provider (covering refunds, rate limits, SLA credits, data retention,
encryption, onboarding, billing, status, support tiers, export, regions,
compliance) and {{ds.n_cases}} evaluation cases: {{ds.n_single_doc}} answerable from a single
document ({{ds.n_paraphrase}} of them worded to avoid the document's vocabulary), {{ds.n_two_doc}}
answerable from a pair, and {{ds.n_unanswerable}} plausible but unanswerable questions.
